title: happy's: a concept site for a Cary cocktail bar
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for a cocktail bar in downtown Cary. Our own idea, not a launched project.
story: happy's is a cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary with a wall covered in smiley faces. This is our own concept. We wanted to see if that personality, a long menu and odd hours could fit on one loud, friendly page. Cream, tomato, cobalt and pink come off the wall. Bricolage Grotesque does the shouting and Space Mono keeps the prices tidy.
goals: Make a long menu easy to browse on a phone.
Make the hours easy to find.

features.title: The smiley wall
features.text: The bar's own wall sets the hero and the cream and tomato colors.
features.story: Borders and ink are a hard 1.5px line, so the page feels printed, like a sticker. The hero background changes color with a short fade.

features.title: Color-coded menu
features.text: 60 items in ten sections, with filters, search and a running tab.
features.story: Sixty items is a lot to scroll on a phone. Filters and search help you find a drink, and the tab adds up whatever you tap, like a game. It never leaves the page.

features.title: The walk up
features.text: A 3D staircase built only from CSS, in a native dialog.
features.story: The stairs are how the bar talks about itself, and a plain link wouldn't carry that. It's pure CSS, no video, and it's skipped for anyone with reduced motion on.

features.title: Reviews and rating
features.text: A 4.8 rating from 26 reviews, with highlights on colored cards.

features.title: Hours and sign-up
features.text: Hours, address, directions and an email sign-up.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: The hero, menu and hours on a phone.
